description: Figure 7 is a line chart that displays the average attention rate of a model across different input segments during generation. The x-axis represents the "Position" of the input segment, ranging from 1 to 12. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," measures the average attention rate, with values ranging from 0.25 to 0.70. The chart compares two models: "Standard" (represented by a blue line with circular markers) and "Ours" (represented by an orange line with circular markers). Error bars are included to indicate variance. The "Standard" model shows a general downward trend in attention rate, starting at approximately 0.60 and decreasing to about 0.40. In contrast, the "Ours" model exhibits a more fluctuating pattern, with an initial value of around 0.60, a dip to approximately 0.50, and then a rise to about 0.65 at position 12. The "Ours" model consistently maintains a higher attention rate than the "Standard" model across all positions, with the gap widening towards the end of the sequence.
